purpose: Capture receipts into MIRROR immediately, process deterministic fields without OpenAI API calls, and leave ambiguous identity/reconciliation work for MIRA using the same durable record.
capture_invariant: verify provider/file readback and content hash
create exactly one receipt identity for one purchase

processing.email_receipts: Use message text/HTML and structured order data directly when available; OCR is unnecessary.
processing.image_or_pdf_receipts: Use on-device, local, provider-native, or self-hosted OCR when available. OCR produces candidate text, never canonical product identity by itself.
processing.deterministic_parser: Extract merchant/date/total/line descriptions/SKU-like identifiers before model reconciliation.
processing.mira_reconciliation: A scheduled or interactive MIRA run may inspect pending MIRROR rows, search official retailer sources first, apply unique high-confidence matches, and leave ambiguity for user review.
processing.failure_behavior: Keep the original receipt and processing row open; never discard evidence because parsing or research failed.
